entities.name: Guilds of Ravnica
entities.description: Ten sociopolitical factions that hold power on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: City plane ruled by ten guilds.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Ancient binding spell, document and contract detailing each guild's role; ruled the plane for 10,000 years until broken.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov Syndicate member who drafted a new non-magical document among the guilds.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Ravnican guild led by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Ravnican guild that kept its original guildmaster.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who collaborated with Niv-Mizzet and became the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon who later took on the Guildpact role.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker allied with Aurelia.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Boros leader allied with Gideon.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Ravnican guild.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Acted as Jace's manager.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker whose plan funneled planeswalkers into Ravnica.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Non-native planeswalker who usurped control of the Orzhov.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Non-native planeswalker who usurped control of the Azorius.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Golgari guildmaster who was compleated.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Native who fell under Bolas's sway.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Native who fell under Bolas's sway.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Invasion that united the guilds.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Devastating attack on Ravnica involving compleation.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild compleated and led to the surface by Vraska.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian whose demise left the compleated catatonic.

events.summary: The Guildpact is signed and the guilds rule Ravnica for 10,000 years.
events.quote: the guilds of Ravnica have ruled the plane for 10,000 years

events.summary: After the Guildpact is broken, Teysa Karlov drafts a new non-magical document for cooperation.
events.quote: Teysa Karlov of the Orzhov Syndicate drafted a new, non-magical document amongst the guilds

events.summary: The guilds return to ascendance; most get new guildmasters except the Izzet, Orzhov and Rakdos.
events.quote: the guilds returned and became ascendant

events.summary: Jace collaborates with Niv-Mizzet, Gideon allies with Aurelia, and the Implicit Maze makes Jace the Living Guildpact with Lavinia as manager.
events.quote: The Implicit Maze moved Jace into the central Living Guildpact role

events.summary: Bolas's plan nears fruition; Kaya and Dovin usurp the Orzhov and Azorius while Vraska, Domri and Ral fall under his sway.
events.quote: allowing for non-native planeswalkers Kaya Cassir and Dovin Baan to usurp control

events.summary: The War of the Spark unites the guilds and Niv-Mizzet takes the Guildpact role.
events.quote: letting Niv-Mizzet take on the Guildpact role

events.summary: In the New Phyrexian Invasion, compleated Vraska leads the compleated Golgari to the surface, targeting the Azorius.
events.quote: Guildmaster Vraska was compleated and led the compleated Golgari Swarm to the surface

relations.quote: Jace Beleren collaborated with Niv-Mizzet of the Izzet League
Gideon Jura was in alliance with Aurelia
with Lavinia acting as his manager
